'''Robert Schaak''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Milwaukee tournament]] on 21 October 2000 with Dark Deal, according to Evan Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1393">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-27-egomania-comics-10-21-2000d1393/ egomania-comics-10-21-2000], DeckTech (Evan "Lorax" Fitzgerald, 27 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-27-egomania-comics-10-21-2000d1393/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
